This name is reminiscent of the early days of Islam when Prophet Muhammad and his followers would often shelter in caves amidst the desert landscape, seeking refuge and solace in the. The coolness and serenity of dew would signify hope and optimism in the arid world of the Seventh Century Arabian Peninsula.
